# Rebecca Node 1.6.1

Rebecca Node 1.6.1 fixes batched user updates that could miss the panel's deadline, Shadowsocks 2022 user handling on live updates, and validation of Xray replacement configs. It is a drop-in update for Rebecca Node 1.6.0.

## Highlights

- ⚡ **Faster batches** — the config cache is read once per batch and written once at the end, so large batches complete within the panel's deadline.
- 🧩 **Shadowsocks 2022 users** — users are sent as key accounts, and the cipher and method come from each inbound's own configuration on live adds, batch upserts, and config diffs.
- 🛡️ **Safer config validation** — replacement configs are validated with WireGuard outbounds in userspace mode, so kernel WireGuard devices no longer make every config change fail.
- 🏷️ **Dev build tags** — dev update tags must be a commit hash of 7 to 40 hex characters, matching the panel's rule.

## Reliability and compatibility

- The applied configuration is unchanged by the WireGuard validation fix.
- Existing node identity, certificates, and managed runtime settings are retained on upgrade.

## Upgrade notes

> Nodes on 1.6.0 can update to 1.6.1 in place. No configuration changes are needed. Upgrade Rebecca and Rebecca Node together.
